candidate_profiles.first_probe: up-only or up+down top 0.5-1.0GiB. Start small to protect gate cache and TTFT.
candidate_profiles.promotion_precondition: dev-set min/mean token rate improves over no-prompt-specific baseline mean=2.18 min=1.8, correctness passes, memory_peak<=16GB including page cache, TTFT recorded and not promoted if over gate.

implementation_order: Add default-off env parsing in moe_stream.cu; unset behavior unchanged.
Generate small calibration hotset profile TSV from existing dev fallback CSVs.
Run short calibration France smoke with GPU-only diagnostics disabled first; then run full calibration_dev_set_v1 only if smoke improves or at least does not regress badly.
Do not run held-out until candidate is frozen.
problem: Naive ffn_up_exps/ffn_down_exps one-stream removes CPU fallback locally but streams too many uncached experts, causing cache pressure and transfer overhead. Need a mode that tries GPU only for calibration-selected hot experts and leaves the rest on CPU fallback.

proposed_default_off_envs.GGML_MOE_STREAM_CACHE_ADMIT_PROFILE_APPL: comma/colon tensor-name filter; when set, cache admit profile restricts only matching tensors, while non-matching tensors keep default cache admission. This preserves gate cache while applying a calibration hotset to up/down.
proposed_default_off_envs.GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_REQUIRE_CACHE_ADMIT_: comma/colon tensor-name filter; when a matching tensor is not admitted by the cache profile and is not already cached, ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one returns false so CPU fallback handles it instead of uncached GPU streaming.

theoretical_limit: Even a perfect 3GiB hotset covers only 28.4% of measured fallback, so this is an incremental candidate, not a complete >5 tok/s route. If 1-3GiB probes do not improve dev-set end-to-end, close hotset-gated streaming and move to a more structural representation/model route.
